 New frontier, same timeless spirit. 
 After 16 years of making memories over exceptional cocktails at Clover Club, we’re thrilled to announce we're embarking on a new frontier.
 Enter The Saloon
 Serving exceptional drinks and laid back vibes since 2008.
 Part neighborhood institution, part destination cocktail bar, Clover Club is proud to welcome guests from around the world, and around the corner, to gather and enjoy expertly prepared cocktails and delicious food amidst Brooklyn’s relaxed, yet crackling, energy.

 We believe true craftsmanship exists in the balance between tradition and innovation.
 We find our inspiration in 19th century classic cocktails - back when a cocktail was just one type of mixed drink alongside sours, juleps, daisies, and royales - rejuvenating them through modern techniques, unique ingredients, and unexpected flavor pairings. Our passion lies in finding a way to make an old drink taste excitingly new, yet comfortingly familiar, and above all else, irresistibly delicious. 
 “Who enters here leaves care behind, leaves sorrow behind, leaves petty envies and jealousies behind.”
 So went the motto of the original Clover Club, a select group of Philadelphia journalists who, from 1882 until the 1920’s met once a month at the Bellevue Hotel to drink and eat and talk. Here at the new Clover Club, we’ve been striving to follow in those old-time Philadelphians’ footsteps since we opened back in 2008.
 Our cocktails 
 An unassuming love letter to our beloved Brooklyn, a borough filled with flow and soul where people can gather, eat and imbibe long into the night. 
 We’re here for our neighbors. For those who revel in things uniquely made and finely done. For the cocktail newbies and curious wanderers.
 Cheers.

 Bar Camillo
 Opened in 2020, Bar Camillo is a Roman bar and restaurant located in the heart of Bed-Stuy, Brooklyn with a menu focused on pinsa , an ancient style of Roman pizza. Made using a mixture of organic wheat & rice flours and left to rise for over 48 hours, the resulting crust is lighter, crispier, and more easily digestible than your typical Neapolitan pizza. Topped with a wide variety of traditional ingredients like artichokes, prosciutto cotto, guanciale, anchovies and mushrooms, and using only imported fior di latte mozzarella from Campania, each pinsa is then finished in Bar Camillo’s imported Moretti Forni oven specifically designed for this type of pizza. 
 Bar Camillo’s menu also has a large selection of Roman antipasti, as well as a few spins on classic dishes from the Eternal City such as baked cacio e pepe, and roasted polletto.
 Named after Count Camillo Negroni, the alleged creator of the negroni, Bar Camillo’s beverage program features many variations of the iconic cocktail along with a large selection of wines on tap, craft beer, spritzes, aperitivi, whiskey and amari.
 SUONO
 Underneath the restaurant, lies SUONO, an intimate music venue with custom built vintage speakers, vinyl turntables and a meticulously crafted sound system. Each week, SUONO hosts some of the city’s best DJs for all-vinyl sets featuring a variety of sounds, styles and grooves. Free entry. A unique sound experience you have to hear for yourself.

 About us 
 Welcome to Savelli’s, our charming neighborhood restaurant that has recently opened. Located in the heart of Brooklyn. We’ve dedicated ourselves to authentic Italian cuisine and genuine hospitality. Family-owned and operated Savelli’s Italian restaurant that loves sharing our heritage with you through the traditional food we make in a warm, welcoming, and relaxed Mediterranean atmosphere.
 About Us 
 Parties 
 The restaurant 
 Dominick Palumbo was born in Reggio Calabria, Italy and moved to the US when he was only 11 years old. he grew up more as an American than as an Italian, but his heritage and roots have never really left him. as years passed, Dominick started realizing more and more that every time he went to an Italian restaurant he wasn't satisfied with the food and what each place offered wasn't fully authentic. Therefore, after a long experience as real estate investor he decided to open his own restaurant to offer new yorkers the opportunity to experience his vision of authentic Italian cuisine. The restaurants' name is a combination of both his son Saverio and his nephew Elis' first names. Not only is the name Savelli southern but it is the name of a southern town in Italy. The restaurant Savelli is dedicated for the love of family.
 Events 
 The bar 
 The bar offers a full list of refreshing seasonal cocktails, as well as artisanal Italian wines and classic Californian selections.

 The Menu 
 At Savellis, we aim to bring people together with timeless Italian dishes and exceptional service. With our fresh homemade garden pesto, delicious Italian polpette (meatballs), arancini (rice balls), to pizza with round 12" or the long 29". To complete the Italian dinner the restaurant offers their homemade classic napoleon, tiramisu and fresh cannoli.

 About us
 Welcome to Savelli’s, our charming neighborhood restaurant that has recently opened. Located in the heart of Brooklyn. We’ve dedicated ourselves to authentic Italian cuisine and genuine hospitality. Family-owned and operated Savelli’s Italian restaurant that loves sharing our heritage with you through the traditional food we make in a warm, welcoming, and relaxed Mediterranean atmosphere.
 THE RESTAURANT 
 Dominick Palumbo was born in Reggio Calabria, Italy and moved to the US when he was only 11 years old. he grew up more as an American than as an Italian, but his heritage and roots have never really left him. as years passed, Dominick started realizing more and more that every time he went to an Italian restaurant he wasn’t satisfied with the food and what each place offered wasn’t fully authentic. Therefore, after a long experience as real estate investor he decided to open his own restaurant to offer new yorkers the opportunity to experience his vision of authentic Italian cuisine. The restaurants’ name is a combination of both his son Saverio and his nephew Elis’ first names. Not only is the name Savelli southern but it is the name of a southern town in Italy. The restaurant Savelli is dedicated for the love of family.
 THE BAR 
 The bar offers a full list of refreshing seasonal cocktails, as well as artisanal Italian wines and classic Californian selections.
 THE MENU 
 At Savellis, we aim to bring people together with timeless Italian dishes and exceptional service. With our fresh homemade garden pesto, delicious Italian polpette (meatballs), arancini (rice balls), to pizza with round 12” or the long 29”. To complete the Italian dinner the restaurant offers their homemade classic napoleon, tiramisu and fresh cannoli.
 THE CELLAR 
 The cellar was designed as a cozy and sophisticated ambiance helps set stage for every kind of gathering, from Sunday family dinners, happy hour with friends to private parties and dinners, birthdays, baby showers and weddings.
 PRIVATE PARTIES 
 Enjoy our outdoor dining garden patio for dinner underneath the beautiful lights and a garden waterfall. You may enjoy with family gatherings or a group of great friends. Our restaurant is divided into two levels where we have room for up to 40 guests in the garden room and room for 50 guests in the cellar. Savelli will host your wedding, baby/bridal shower, rehearsal dinner, family & business event, Holiday parties and cocktail party.
 The mission is simple: at Savelli, quality is our top priority.

 Café Zona Sur
 Jose and Maria wanted to open a place they'd want to go to in their neighborhood of Sunset Park.
 For years, they worked in all kinds of restaurants, 4-stars, 2-stars, no Stars, brunch, lunch, dinner; from Manhattan to Los Angeles making and serving delicious food. 
 They want Café Zona Sur to represent their journey with food. The Menu is fresh, simple and local. It's New American and indicative of the kitchens they've worked in for twenty years and the cultures that have traveled here to the Great NYC and helped revolutionize the comfort meal.
 At Café Zona Sur, the espresso is just as important as the wine and beer, and the menu is filled with dishes that represent their journey as foodies.
 Excited to be in Brooklyn, they also support local bakers and artisans and serve local and natural whenever possible as well as Fair Trade Espresso Coffee and Teas.
 This is their first venture in their neighborhood of Sunset Park and look forward to many more.

 Hollow Nickel is a casual neighborhood bar and restaurant located in Boerum Hill, Brooklyn. Opened in August 2012, it is owned and operated by three friends that drew inspiration from the little known and intriguing story of the 1953 Hollow Nickel Case .
 tHE CASE 
 The case began with a 14 year old Brooklyn Eagle newspaper boy who collected a five cent piece that felt too light to him. When he dropped it on the ground, it popped open to disclose a microfilm containing a series of numbers. The microfilm went on to reveal a complex web of espionage involving the KGB, the U.S. Atomic Program and the U.S. Navy.

 Italian Cooking Rooted in Family, Grown on Our Rooftop
 Every dish at Rosemary's starts with a memory. Founder Carlos Suarez grew up watching his mother, Rosemary, cook with love at the family's kitchen table, and later found inspiration in his parents' vegetable garden, or orto, overlooking the hills of Lucca, Italy. That heartfelt, ingredient-driven hospitality is what he brought to the West Village in 2012, complete with a rooftop garden that still supplies fresh herbs and produce to the kitchen today. As Rosemary's grew to the East Side and Midtown, the mission stayed the same: seasonal cooking and the kind of neighborly hospitality that makes every location feel like home.
 Read Our Full Story → 
 Seasonal, Sustainable, and Made In-House
 Rooftop-Grown Produce
 Fresh herbs and vegetables grown in our own West Village rooftop garden, harvested to supplement a seasonal, chef-driven menu.
 Handmade Pasta, Daily
 Fresh pasta made in-house, from rigatoni to our signature orecchiette.
 A Proper Spritz Bar
 Aperitivo-style cocktails, wines from small, family-owned producers, and Italian classics built for long lunches and easy dinners.
 Local & Sustainable Partners
 We work with Brooklyn Grange, Halal Pastures Farm, Lani’s Farm, and Eckerton Hill Farm to source responsibly.
 Three Neighborhoods, One Rosemary's
 Whether you're planning a seasonal dinner in the West Village, a neighborhood meal on the East Side, or a pre-theater bite in Midtown, Rosemary's brings the same handmade pasta and neighborly hospitality to every table.

 Our Story
 Welcome to Rosemary’s, where our passion for seasonal Italian cooking and neighborly hospitality fuel our mission to bring people together. What is now a restaurant brand with three locations in New York, started back in the 1980s at my family’s kitchen table where every night my mom Rosemary poured her heart into cooking for me and my dad, Raul.
 While we moved around a lot when I was young — Europe, Asia, US — a few constants shone through: my father’s cherished copper pots that hung next to the kitchen table in every kitchen, and my mom’s devotion to her guests, expressed through her meticulous table settings and delicious cooking.
 Years later, when I began visiting my folks at their home in Lucca, with their gorgeous vegetable garden, or orto, and view from the dinner table overlooking the valley, I knew that I wanted to share their simple, elegant and heartfelt expression of hospitality with the world.
 Since opening Rosemary’s in the West Village in 2012, with its rooftop farm, string lights and view overlooking Jefferson Market Garden — all inspired by my folk’s home — the restaurant has grown into a neighborhood institution beloved by all walks of life.
 Over the years we’ve partnered with many incredible local groups, who share our values and passion for environmental stewardship and community engagement — from Brooklyn Grange, to PS41, to God’s Love We Deliver.
 If you appreciate quality seasonal cooking, everyday elegance and neighborly hospitality, I welcome you to come in for a meal and join the Rosemary’s community.
 Carlos Suarez
 Founder 
 Our Local Partners in Sustainability
 Beneath our dedication to service lies an unwavering commitment to forging a more sustainable future. Through numerous partnerships with local producers, in addition to our West Village rooftop garden, our fresh ingredients cater to diverse budgets without compromising quality or our values.
 At Rosemary’s, dining transcends the culinary experience — it is a celebration of thoughtful living rooted in cherished childhood memories. We extend a warm invitation for you to join a community that embraces hospitality, sustainability, and the joy of sharing exceptional pastas and wine — whatever the occasion may be.

 The Inn by Fumo, located in Harlem, serves New Yorkers tasteful New American dishes focused on comfort food. Join us for dinner, happy hour or brunch, or use our catering services, daily delivery, and takeout options. 
 Try everything from our Chicken Chicken Specialties like Chicken Wings and Tenders, Chicken Sandwiches, Chicken and Waffles, Peruvian Style Slow Cooked Rotisserie Chicken, to our delicious seafood dishes, featuring Pan Seared Catfish, Lobster Rolls, Lobster Mac and Cheese, Mussels and Fries, Lemon White Butter Sauce Grilled Salmon. 
 Amazing selection of Italian Wines and delicious Cocktails, served in a Organic Modern decor and a dreamy ambiance.

 Welcome to Tasca
 Tasca, which is Iberian for "Tavern," brings together the vibrant flavors and culinary traditions of both Spain and the Latin countries of the Caribbean. Offering an elevated and innovative interpretation of Spain, Puerto Rico, the Dominican Republic, and Cuba's shared food histories, Tasca seamlessly ties together the evolution of their cuisines. In a multi-level, 5,500-square-foot space complete with several open, airy dining areas, a patio, and a subterranean lounge and private dining wine cellar, Tasca conveys both the warmth of a traditional Spanish tavern and the breezy elegance of a contemporary, coastal Caribbean restaurant. Located steps from Central Park, the American Museum of Natural History, the Beacon Theatre, and Lincoln Center.
 Join us for Dinner, Brunch or Happy Hour. 
 We look forward to hosting you soon. 
 Buen Provecho!

 Our Menu
 Tasca offers a contemporary blend of Spanish and Latin Caribbean cuisines, paying homage to the traditional recipes of Spain, Puerto Rico, the Dominican Republic, and Cuba with a modern culinary update. Choose from an eclectic assortment of tapas and appetizers at the bar or venture into the alluring main dining room for a selection of innovative dishes with authentic flavors.

 Private Dining
 We would love to host your next event.
 With a variety of unique event spaces, Tasca is available for large-party bookings and full restaurant buyouts. Our venue, includes an intimate downstairs lounge complete with fireplace in our private dining wine cellar, which can accommodate any occasion from dinner with friends, birthday parties and family gatherings to corporate presentations and standing cocktail receptions for 200 guests.
 Our dedicated team looks forward to working with you!

 Tasca offers an elevated, contemporary blend of Spanish and Latin-Caribbean cuisines, paying homage to the traditional recipes and flavors of Spain, Puerto Rico, the Dominican Republic, and Cuba. 
 Start with an eclectic array of tapas, Spanish flatbreads, pintxos, and craft cocktails before enjoying our crudo and ceviche, slow-roasted asados, pescado a la plancha, and large-format paellas for two paired with fine wines and rums from around the world. 
 Our expansive wine cellar showcases over 300 wine bottles with options ranging from an array of Spanish varietals to wines from Napa Valley and the Canary Islands. In addition to an innovative craft cocktail list, Tasca also offers NYC's largest selection of rum, with over 100 premium bottles including rare and vintage varieties.

 Years ago, restaurateur Jay Espinal and his wife Norisa craved authentic yet elevated expressions of the Latin-Caribbean cuisines they had a natural affinity for. This led them to open their own critically acclaimed restaurant, Don Pedro's on the Upper East Side, which remained a favorite among locals and visitors alike for over 15 years, winning rave reviews including being voted Top Latin Restaurant in Manhattan by Zagat. 
 Now, with years of experience in the NYC culinary scene under their belts, they've brought their new venture, Tasca, to the food-loving locals of the Upper West Side. A place to enjoy incredible food, wine, and cocktails in a sophisticated yet convivial environment, Tasca is conveniently located within walking distance of some of the area's cultural mainstays like Central Park, Lincoln Center, and The Beacon Theater. 
 Jay and Norisa welcome you to come and experience the lively energy and captivating space at Tasca, whether for a date night, celebratory dinner with friends, or a private event. From our table to yours, Salud!

 Tasca offers an elevated, contemporary blend of Spanish and Latin-Caribbean cuisines, paying homage to the traditional recipes and flavors of Spain, Puerto Rico, the Dominican Republic, and Cuba. 
 Start with an eclectic array of tapas, Spanish flatbreads, pintxos, and craft cocktails before enjoying our crudo and ceviche, slow-roasted asados, pescado a la plancha, and large-format paellas for two paired with fine wines and rums from around the world. 
 Our expansive wine cellar showcases over 300 wine bottles with options ranging from an array of Spanish varietals to wines from Napa Valley and the Canary Islands. In addition to an innovative craft cocktail list, Tasca also offers NYC's largest selection of rum, with over 100 premium bottles including rare and vintage varieties.

 Justin Royal is an NYC-based musician whose original recordings span the psychedelic, an almost folk-like sensibility, and a deep connection to the blues.  Tuesday November 10th

A prolific tunesmith, Lorenzo is touring and promoting his new record (and first vinyl issue) “radical, or, all the good revolutionaries are dead (cuz we killed them)” which UK music blog Various Small Flames just praised as “a howl of despair, a statement of intent, and a timely reminder of the power of collaboration and community” Backed in his band by dear friends and collaborators, the formerly solo and acoustic project has electrified and swelled to become a real live rock and roll party.   An ardent Liverpool supporter, Lorenzo always loves returning to his favorite lil boozer in the world, the 11th Street Bar, and playing for the friends and community where his songwriting took shape.

 Sanford: is the brainchild of Brooklyn based, but South Carolina born musician Jay Sanford. He does all of the writing, arranging, and performing for his recorded music, including his previous original releases: “Gone to Hell” and “Farewell”. Pulling from a wide range of musical influences, Sanford: curates his live show setlists across genres and decades. From Hank Williams to Phoebe Bridgers to Sam Cooke to Joy Division to Fats Waller to The Rolling Stones, he subscribes to the idea that good music is good music…And to quote Frank Zappa, “Music is the best”.  Catch them here the first Thursday of every other month.

 Marc’s life has been about pursuing twin passions: creating and recording his American roots songs, and exploring remote areas of the desert and mountain West. After signing his first publishing contract while in law school, he fronted rock bands and performed regularly in New York City clubs like CBGB, Wetlands, and The Knitting Factory.  Marc and Co-Producer Mike Ricciardi now present RIDE, ten cinematic recordings reflecting his romantic connection to the American West and exploring the value of its myths to contemporary culture.

 The Hugh Pool Band has a residency here at 11th St. Bar on the third Thursday of each month unless Hugh’s out of town rocking the rest of America. Hugh is a musician, songwriter, producer, and member of the New York Blues Hall of Fame who plays guitar in a unique style that melds traditional Delta blues, country music and classic and psychedelic rock and roll. His instrument of choice is a National Steel Triolian, a resonator guitar somewhat like a Dobro, played with a spark plug wrench through an Ibanez TS-9 overdrive pedal and a Dunlop Dyna comp compressor. He also plays Harmonica, Banjo, Lap Steel, Mandolin, sings and plays standard electric guitars. He is joined by Ken Rich on Bass and either Keith Robinson or James Wormsworth on drums.   www.HughPool.com

 About us
 From renowned Chef Rafael Haid comes 1803 NYC, the best party on this side of the Mississippi River! Inspired by New Orleans’ vibrant culinary scene and rich culture and named for the Louisiana Purchase, 1803 transports you from the Big Apple to the Big Easy with its stunning balcony seating, covered outdoor seating, and prohibition speakeasy bar, Bon Courage. The good times keep on rolling with live music and special events daily, a stellar menu highlighted by Cajun-Creole dishes and NOLA classics (think Seafood Gumbo and beignets!), and delicious, carefully crafted cocktails 
 Named for the year of the infamous Louisiana Purchase, 1803 injects New York sophistication into the Spanish, French, and Cajun food traditions that lend New Orleans' cooking its explosive flavor and sexy appeal. The menu, which features lunch, dinner, and late night bites, ranges from the simple pleasures of fresh-shucked oysters to the Deep South decadence of smothered pork chops and grits. Its extensive, thoughtful wine list and New Orleans-inflected cocktail and beer offerings are perfect complements to this transportive dining experience.

 Peter D:
 Loved this place! Staying less than a block away and it was a delicious meal. We had wings, nachos and a burger. The food was out in minutes and the quality was outstanding, even though the place was packed. Fun atmosphere and friendly staff, Highly recommended!!
 review by - Yelp
 Evan M:
 Loved this place. I had been wanting to go here for a long time but never had the chance. Happy hour deals here are great. Everything is clean, the service is awesome and fast, and the food is really good. I only tried the empanadas and the wings but they were both super tasty...
 review by - Yelp
 Upper W:
 Great neighborhood place that has great drinks (haven't had food yet), music and vibe. Happy hour is awesome and lots of seating. The story behind this place is cool - it was a bodega and turned into a bar. I used to live around the corner when it was a bodega!
 review by - Yelp
 Ashley M:
 This place has a huge outdoor seating area with tvs and the inside with tv at each of the booths, a few high tables and bar seating. It has cute decor and friendly staff. Went here after work and got drinks and some small bites and it was all good. Very tasty!

 About us 
 A Taste of Italy in the Heart of the Bronx
 Michaelangelo's Restaurant is one of Arthur Avenue’s hotspots and it's a must-see place. We are dedicated to providing authentic Italian-American food in the atmosphere you would experience in Italy. Our coal-fired brick oven, dating back to the early 1900 's, has been restored and is one of New York's largest brick ovens. The flavors it creates are second to none. Our chefs use only the freshest ingredients and have created a classic menu composed of pizza, pasta, seafood and meats. Open year round, our outdoor patio is a great place to plan an event or to enjoy an intimate dinner with a loved one.
